research_goal: under sparse causal sensing, choose every 10 minutes which subset of the 109 supervisory targets to change and by how much, leave every other target latched at its previous commanded value, and minimize system-wide cumulative TFV with authoritative SWMM used only for offline calibration/evaluation

core_pipeline.step1: causal sparse sensors -> current full-network hydraulic reconstruction
core_pipeline.step2: causal state + causal rainfall + current target-latch reference/candidate H360 action -> predicted delta TFV
core_pipeline.sequence_support: D3 TrainFit q95 joint temporal trust region prevents continuous optimizer extrapolation
core_pipeline.coordinated_direction: all-109 screening plus support-contracted H120/H360 V6/V7 optimizer supplies a system-level control direction
core_pipeline.first_move_refinement: optimize independent shrink factors only on facilities changed by the supported upstream first move, then apply TFV-objective-consistent backward pruning that returns a facility exactly to the previous target whenever removal does not worsen predicted TFV; every other facility remains exactly at the previous supervisory target
core_pipeline.first_move_counterfactual: write the refined target now and, if no later command arrives, keep that new target latched through H360; do not revert to the pre-decision target after H10
core_pipeline.first_move_admission: fresh Development authoritative SWMM labels the same target-latched first-move query; 90% rainfall-group split conformal uses residual/sqrt(actual first-move changed-facility count), with at least 24 rainfall groups; calibration and runtime must share the same byte-level first-move source fingerprint
core_pipeline.runtime: execute only when refined target-latch predicted delta TFV plus its action-density-normalized margin is negative; after 10 minutes observe again and optionally change a new subset, while all other targets retain the last command
core_pipeline.swmm: authoritative offline calibration/evaluation only; never inside online candidate search

action_contract.engineering_bounds: physical min/max plus <=0.5 target movement per 10-minute update
action_contract.per_facility_support: TrainFit q95 first-move and sequence magnitude
action_contract.joint_temporal_support: D3-HOLD q95 first-block L1, H120 L1 and H120 temporal total variation

scientific_bottleneck.evidence: The authoritative runtime stores and reasserts the last commanded 109-dimensional target until the next explicit command, but V10 calibrated EXECUTE_H10_THEN_HOLD_ACTIVE_TARGET_H350 by reverting the changed facilities to their pre-decision target after 10 minutes. V10 then passed 0/198 actions even though 15/18 rejected raw plans were authoritatively beneficial. This counterfactual was not the command trajectory the controller would actually produce.
scientific_bottleneck.secondary_issue: V10 calibrated only ten 23-facility queries although actual proposed first moves varied from 13 to 23 facilities, making a single absolute margin poorly aligned with action density.
scientific_bottleneck.mechanism_under_test: whether target-latch-consistent first-move valuation plus exact-query normalized conformal calibration restores action availability without reintroducing optimizer false-benefit
scientific_bottleneck.next_test: build at least 24 fresh Development rainfall groups, label one target-latched refined first-move query plus previous-target latch reference per group, calibrate normalized conformal admission, then test on new preregistered Development events

promotion_rule: on new preregistered Development events require nonzero but reliable target changes, zero support/engineering/readback violations, event-level TFV non-inferiority to No-control, representative target-latched first-move SWMM replay with low false-beneficial rate, and transparent PFV/Global-Peak reporting; only then consider untouched Validation
